Actions.Text: AMEND (T) AND RECOMMIT TO REAL PROPERTY TAXATION

Title: Improves affordability and the recruitment and retention of volunteer firefighters and volunteer ambulance workers through local tax incentives
Summary: Increases the tax exemption on real property owned by members of volunteer fire companies or voluntary ambulance services in certain counties.
LawCode: Amd §466-a, RPT L; amd §606, Tax L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the tax law, in relation to eligibility for the volunteer firefighters' and ambulance workers' credit; and to amend the real property tax law, in relation to improving affordability and the recruitment and retention of volunteer firefighters and volunteer ambulance workers through local tax incentives
